decisions.reason: As a new product closely fitting the firm's natural facial-care core and already given its own page, it is likely to be retained while the growing market and recent launch are tested further.
This serum is close to the established offer and suits current skincare demand, so a small firm would usually keep it for another year despite the weaker website emphasis so far.

The cleansing milk fits the firm's existing range and customer base, but because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, the chance of discontinuation is somewhat higher if sales stay modest.
